en.title: GTA 6 Launch Sparks 17% Surge in Time Off Requests
en.summary: The immense anticipation for Grand Theft Auto VI is translating into real-world actions, with a significant spike in employee time-off requests coinciding with its release date. This phenomenon highlights the cultural impact of Rockstar's flagship franchise.
en.body:
The wait for **Grand Theft Auto VI** is almost over, and it seems millions of fans are already planning their escape routes – from work, that is. New data reveals a remarkable surge in time-off requests specifically for November 19, the highly anticipated release date of Rockstar Games' latest masterpiece. HR software company BambooHR reported an increase of between 9% and 17% in paid time-off submissions for that particular Thursday, a notable deviation from typical request patterns for the third week of November.

While it's impossible to confirm every single request is solely for **GTA 6**, the timing is too significant to ignore. This level of anticipation is not just limited to the United States; reports indicate that even Australian workers are strategically requesting leave to dive into Vice City on day one, prompting HR departments globally to prepare for potential staffing adjustments. Economists have even projected a potential $1 billion dip in U.S. productivity, a testament to the sheer scale of this gaming phenomenon.

## The Pull of Vice City

Rockstar Games isn't just relying on pent-up demand; they've orchestrated a marketing blitz that mirrors the game's ambition. From a colossal neon pink sign atop the Miami Heat's arena to immersive in-universe advertisements plastered across the city, the **GTA 6** hype machine is in full swing. Fans in Miami can even experience a real-life Burger Shot, a fictional fast-food chain from the **Grand Theft Auto** universe. Adding to the spectacle, an unprecedented NBA game on November 18 will see the Miami Heat transform into the 'Vice City Heat,' donning **GTA 6**-themed jerseys and playing on a custom Vice City court. This elaborate campaign serves as a final, high-impact marketing beat before the game drops, ensuring maximum cultural penetration.

## A Massive Event for Gamers

This isn't just another game release; it's shaping up to be one of the biggest entertainment launches in history. The sheer volume of time-off requests underscores the deep connection players have with the **Grand Theft Auto** series and the immense value they place on experiencing its world from the moment it becomes available. For many, November 19 isn't just a date on the calendar; it's the start of a new adventure in a meticulously crafted, sprawling open world that promises unparalleled freedom and immersion. The community's willingness to rearrange their professional lives for a game speaks volumes about its cultural significance.

## What's Next

**Grand Theft Auto VI** is set to launch on November 19 for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. Fans can expect the game to dominate conversations and online communities for weeks, if not months, following its release.

content_raw: GTA 6's release has led to as much as a 17% increase in time-off requests, according to a new report. As reported by Money.com , new data from HR software company BambooHR revealed that there has been a notable spike in time-off requests for November 19. BambooHR revealed that there has been an increase between 9% to 17% on November 19, compared to normal requests for the third Thursday in November. While we aren't sure if every single person is taking that day off to play GTA 6, it stands to reason that this is what the bulk of these requests are for. Economists have estimated a $1 billion loss in productivity in the United States due to GTA 6's release. While we'll just have to wait and see what kind of impact the game has on the world, it is clear that this is a massive event. There's a high level of anticipation for GTA 6, and it is expected to have one of the biggest entertainment launches of all time, if not the biggest. Rockstar has also been spending a ton of money to get the word out with extravagant marketing; it spent $975,000 to install a massive neon pink sign on top of the Miami Heat's arena, after all. The developer also covered the city with in-universe ads for brands in the game, along with more traditional banners featuring the game's key art. Fans can even eat at a real life version of Burger Shot , a fast food chain in the GTA universe, if they live in Miami. There will also be an unprecedented NBA game between the Miami Heat and the Milwaukee Bucks on November 18, which will turn the Heat into the Vice City Heat . They will play with GTA 6-themed jerseys on a never-before-seen Vice City court. It should be quite the spectacle, and serve as an effective final marketing beat for the game. GTA 6 will release on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. A PC port is also rumored for early 2027.
